checks.check: declared task fields resolve to publisher columns in the selected extract
checks.observed: resolved 14 of 14 declared features; release count label source column hazmatreleasedcars; accident year column year; grade-crossing identifier column gxid

checks.check: published title claim of no grade crossings does not hold in the source block and crossing records are excluded
checks.observed: 1817 hazmat accidents with a non-empty gxid or a crossing accident type were excluded; 1796 carried a non-empty gxid and 46 of those excluded rows were positive before exclusion; 45 gxid positives and 38 crossing-type positives overlap; shipped rows still carrying gxid 0 and shipped rows still typed crossing 0
checks.expected: the source snapshot contains a crossing block even though the view title says not at grade crossings; no shipped row may carry a non-empty gxid or the accident types Hwy-rail crossing or RR grade crossing

checks.check: population holds only non-crossing accidents with at least one hazmat car inside the agreed accident years
checks.observed: 27244 source rows scanned; 0 with a zero hazmat car count; 0 without a parseable hazmat car count; 0 hazmat accidents outside the year range; 1817 crossing records excluded; 0 dropped for an unknown release count; 0 dropped without a usable date; 25427 shipped
checks.expected: publisher SoQL reports 27,244 hazmat-car accidents before crossing exclusion, and the live source block carries 1,797 gxid rows and 1,756 Hwy-rail crossing rows; this build removes both kinds before labeling, so every shipped row has at least one hazmat car, an accident year from 1975 through 2026, an empty gxid and a non-crossing accident type

checks.check: release target derived only from the recorded hazmat release count after crossing exclusion
checks.observed: 1889 positives and 23538 negatives across 25427 rows; base rate 0.0743
checks.expected: publisher SoQL reports 1,935 releases among 27,244 hazmat-car accidents before crossing exclusion; after removing the measured crossing block fewer positives remain, so the rate stays near 0.07 and is not treated as the pre-exclusion count
